text.sr:
Potpis funkcije: ovde je većina TypeScript-a.

- `<T, K extends string | number>` su dva parametra tipa. `T` je tip elementa niza. `K` je tip ključa i ograničen je na `string | number`, jer samo oni mogu biti ključevi objekta. `extends` ovde znači „mora biti podskup od“.
- `items: T[]` je ulazni niz elemenata tipa `T`.
- `getKey: (item: T) => K` je funkcija (callback) koja za jedan element vraća njegov ključ. Pozivalac je piše, npr. `(n) => n % 2 === 0 ? 'even' : 'odd'`.
- `Record<K, T[]>` je tip rezultata: objekat čiji su ključevi tipa `K`, a vrednosti nizovi elemenata `T[]`.
- `{` otvara telo; zatvara ga `}` u liniji 8.

Primer: `groupBy([1, 2, 3], (n) => n % 2 === 0 ? 'even' : 'odd')` daje `T = number`, `K = 'even' | 'odd'`, pa je rezultat tipa `Record<'even' | 'odd', number[]>`.
text.en:
The function signature: this is where most of the TypeScript is.

- `<T, K extends string | number>` are two type parameters. `T` is the type of an array element. `K` is the type of the key and is limited to `string | number`, because only those can be object keys. `extends` here means “must be a subset of”.
- `items: T[]` is the input array of elements of type `T`.
- `getKey: (item: T) => K` is a function (callback) that returns the key for one element. The caller writes it, e.g. `(n) => n % 2 === 0 ? 'even' : 'odd'`.
- `Record<K, T[]>` is the result type: an object whose keys are of type `K` and whose values are arrays of elements `T[]`.
- `{` opens the body; it is closed by `}` on line 8.

Example: `groupBy([1, 2, 3], (n) => n % 2 === 0 ? 'even' : 'odd')` gives `T = number`, `K = 'even' | 'odd'`, so the result is of type `Record<'even' | 'odd', number[]>`.

text.sr:
Pravimo prazan objekat koji punimo u petlji.

- `const groups = {}` pravi prazan objekat; `const` jer se promenljiva ne dodeljuje ponovo (sadržaj objekta se menja).
- Problem: `{}` nije dodeljiv tipu `Record<K, T[]>`, jer nedostaju ključevi.
- `as Record<K, T[]>` je **tvrdnja tipa** (type assertion): kažemo kompajleru „veruj nam, ovaj objekat će imati te ključeve kad ga popunimo“. Pri izvršavanju `as` ne radi ništa, jer se briše zajedno sa ostalim tipovima.
text.en:
We create an empty object that we fill in the loop.

- `const groups = {}` creates an empty object; `const` because the variable is not reassigned (the object's contents change).
- The problem: `{}` is not assignable to the type `Record<K, T[]>`, because the keys are missing.
- `as Record<K, T[]>` is a **type assertion**: we tell the compiler “trust us, this object will have those keys once we fill it”. At runtime `as` does nothing, because it is erased along with the other types.

text.sr:
Prolazimo kroz sve elemente, redom.

- `for (const item of items)` uzima jedan po jedan element niza `items`; u `item` je u svakom prolazu trenutni element.
- Redosled se čuva, pa su elementi u svakoj grupi u originalnom redosledu.
- `{` otvara telo petlje; zatvara ga `}` u liniji 6.
text.en:
We go through all the elements, in order.

- `for (const item of items)` takes the elements of the array `items` one by one; in `item` there is the current element on each pass.
- The order is preserved, so the items in each group stay in their original order.
- `{` opens the loop body; it is closed by `}` on line 6.

text.sr:
Izračunavamo ključ grupe za ovaj element.

- `getKey(item)` poziva funkciju koju je pozivalac dao i prosleđuje joj trenutni element.
- Rezultat je tipa `K` (string ili broj), jer je to ono što `getKey` vraća.
text.en:
We compute the group key for this element.

- `getKey(item)` calls the function the caller provided and passes it the current element.
- The result is of type `K` (string or number), because that is what `getKey` returns.

text.sr:
Zatvara telo petlje otvoreno u liniji 3.

- `}` je par za `{`. Svaka otvorena `{` mora da ima svoju `}`; ako jedna fali, kod se ne može pročitati (`SyntaxError`).
text.en:
Closes the loop body opened on line 3.

- `}` is the pair of `{`. Every opened `{` must have its `}`; if one is missing, the code cannot be read (`SyntaxError`).

text.sr:
Vraćamo sve grupe.

- Za prazan niz petlja nije dodala nijedan ključ, pa se vraća `{}`, što test traži.
- Napomena: objekti sa ključevima koji su celi brojevi (`1`, `2`) ređaju ključeve rastuće, bez obzira na redosled dodavanja. Elementi unutar svake grupe ipak ostaju u originalnom redosledu.
text.en:
We return all the groups.

- For an empty array the loop added no keys, so `{}` is returned, which the test requires.
- Note: objects with integer keys (`1`, `2`) order their keys ascending, regardless of the order they were added in. The elements inside each group still keep their original order.

Zatvara telo funkcije otvoreno u liniji 1.

- `}` je par za `{`. Svaka otvorena `{` mora da ima svoju `}`; ako jedna fali, kod se ne može pročitati (`SyntaxError`).
text.en:
Closes the function body opened on line 1.

- `}` is the pair of `{`. Every opened `{` must have its `}`; if one is missing, the code cannot be read (`SyntaxError`).

note.sr: `??=` pravi niz samo kad ključ još ne postoji, pa nema posebne grane za prvi element grupe.
note.en: `??=` creates the array only when the key does not exist yet, so there is no special branch for the first item of a group.
